authorization_commit_subject: docs(matching): authorize G14 synthetic match review workspace

checks.name: web_typecheck
checks.detail: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit reported no diagnostics for the six G14 paths or any existing file.

checks.name: full_existing_dev_test_suite
checks.detail: node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts over all eighteen test files, including the new G14 file. No shim was required on Node v22.23.1.

checks.name: focused_g14_test_file
checks.detail: Asserts frozen copy, the eight frozen abstract tokens, exact CO_DISPLAY_COPY_IN_FLOW_ORDER, simultaneous co-display, three fixture rows with the adjacent label, both warnings, unchanged G7/G8 reuse bytes and rendered output, native button order and type, aria navigation/group/live region, transient-only selection, prohibited-behavior absence, the closed nine-path allowlist and production-root isolation.

checks.name: git_diff_check
checks.detail: No whitespace errors. At the time of this check, before creation of this verification artifact, git status --short listed only the five new untracked G14 code/test paths; the staged area was empty and no tracked file was modified. The final closed-path check below covers all six planned paths including this artifact.

checks.name: closed_path_boundary
checks.detail: All six planned paths exist; the three documentation paths stay byte-unchanged and the allowlist still hashes to the frozen value.

checks.name: frozen_copy_and_semantics
checks.detail: Visible copy equals the frozen strings exactly: title and h1 SYNTHETIC MATCH REVIEW WORKSPACE — NOT PRODUCTION APPROVED; MANUAL DEV-ONLY REHEARSAL — NO DEAL EXECUTION; CO-DISPLAY ONLY — NOT COMPARED OR MATCHED; FIXTURE ONLY — NOT MATCHED OR RANKED; PRE-AUTHORED SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — NOT COMPUTED; OWNER-SIDE NEED — SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PARTY_A; TENANT-SIDE CANDIDATE — SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_PARTY_B; HUMAN REHEARSAL DISPOSITION REQUIRED; UI REHEARSAL SELECTION ONLY — NOT APPROVAL; SYNTHETIC_NO_DEAL_EXECUTED plus NO MATCH, SCORE, CONFIDENCE, QUALIFICATION, RISK, RANKING, CONTACT, DEAL OR OUTCOME OCCURRED; controls REHEARSE INTEREST, REHEARSE HOLD, RESET.

checks.name: prohibited_behavior_absence
checks.detail: Static inspection and bounded tests found no implementation of matching, comparison, scoring, confidence, ranking, eligibility or recommendation; no network, API, database, event or router integration; no persistence, storage, cookies, cache, logging or telemetry; no ledger or persistent treatment of the non-occurrence result; no NEXT, BACK, stepper, current-panel hiding, progression or automatic transition; no query or hash state; no custom keyboard handler; no form, editable input, selector or link; no autoplay, timer or randomness; no motion or animation; and no menu, link or router exposure.

checks.name: browser_smoke_headless_chrome
checks.environment_note: The smoke ran as an automated headless Chrome DevTools-protocol session driven from a temporary script outside the repository, removed after the run; it created and changed no repository file. The only browser console entry was Chrome's automatic /favicon.ico request returning 404; no page in apps/web declares a favicon, so the same entry appears for index.html and for the unchanged G13 console, and it is an environment artifact rather than a workspace defect. Keyboard activation used standard CDP key events; an initial rawKeyDown-only Enter event produced no activation and was replaced by the standard keyDown-with-text Enter event, the same shape that activated Space. This is automated evidence and does not replace a human visual and assistive-technology review.

independent_recheck.ordinary_failure_detail: node:os uv_os_get_passwd returned ERR_SYSTEM_ERROR/ENOMEM before tsx loaded the test file.
